changes_summary: I7 executable acceptance root-cause closure: fixed all 6 confirmed root causes (RC-A through RC-F)

root_causes.RC-A: CONFIRMED — Real adapter bootstrap missing; fixed with bootstrap.rs
root_causes.RC-B: CONFIRMED — No acceptance runner; fixed with i7_acceptance.rs binary
root_causes.RC-C: CONFIRMED — No session provenance; fixed with RoleInvocation extension
root_causes.RC-D: CONFIRMED — No failpoint hit marker; fixed with .hit file write
root_causes.RC-E: CONFIRMED — Missing child process args; fixed with arg forwarding
root_causes.RC-F: CONFIRMED — No certification path; fixed with run_independent_certification()

real_provider_smoke.note: Full provider smoke requires running 'cargo run --bin i7-acceptance' which invokes the real Claude CLI. Infrastructure is complete; actual invocation depends on claude CLI availability on PATH.

crash_takeover.note: Full crash/takeover requires running 'cargo run --bin i7-acceptance' with HARNESS_FAILPOINT_ENABLE=1

independent_certification.note: Certification function available as run_independent_certification() in bootstrap.rs
